parts.name: Concrete foundation wall 200, keyed into footing
EPDM sill membrane, turned 40 down the foundation face
PT sill plate 38x140, flush with foundation face
Sealant collar where the bolt passes EPDM and gasket
Gas-permeable clear crushed stone 100
parts.note: Radon rough-in per VBBL 9.13.4.3: vent-pipe inlet near slab centre, gas-permeable layer 100+ beyond the inlet, pipe sealed at the barrier, labelled every 1.8 m, terminates 1.8 m+ from the property line with a 10–12.5 mm screen (shown on plan, outside this slice).

parts.name: 0.25 mm soil-gas / air barrier, lapped 300, up slab edge, taped to ledge
parts.note: Sequence: leave the upstand loose ~150 mm during the pour; after cure fold it over the edge XPS and tape it to the ledge, then EPDM, gasket, sill, framing, then lap and seal the wall poly (DEFG E14).

parts.name: Acoustical sealant bead, wall poly to slab barrier
6 mil poly air/vapour barrier, lapped 104 onto slab barrier
Acoustical sealant bead, poly to sill plate
Fibre-cement floor-edge cap 12, adhered (no fasteners through barrier)
Acoustical sealant bead, poly to top plate
Gypsum ceiling 12.7 (no ceiling poly: roof is exterior-insulated)
Sheathing 12, bottom flush with sill underside
Base flashing 24 ga prefinished steel, lap 75 over sill joint, 10% leg, 45 deg drip
Flashing fasteners at 300 o.c. into sill plate (under membrane lap)
Sheathing membrane, shingled over flashing upstand
Exterior rigid mineral wool 50, 128+ kg/m3
parts.note: Stucco is hung on strapping screwed through 50 mm mineral wool: screw size and spacing to be confirmed by a structural engineer (RDH13 3-46).

parts.name: Strapping screws 6 mm through insulation into studs, 300 o.c. from y 375
Perforated insect screen across cavity and insulation base
Galvanized line wire 1.2 at 150, backing the paper between straps
Self-furred galvanized lath, 6 mm off paper
Lath screws with 25 mm washers into strapping, 150 o.c.
parts.note: Lath fastened into 19 mm strapping, not 25 mm into framing: alternative solution under 9.27.5.7(3) / 9.28.4.6(2), needs engineer or manufacturer acceptance.

parts.name: Three-coat cement stucco 25
parts.note: Vertical control joints at 4.57 m max and at opening corners, through the lath; no T or L panels (CMHC 7-17). Stucco +230 is 30 above the 200 minimum: the decades view flags grade rise over 30 mm.

parts.name: Zinc-alloy casing bead, 10+ above flashing, left open
Cement parging 12 on lath, 150 below grade to flashing
Insulation anchors with 50 mm washers into concrete
Roof joists 38x235, 600 cantilever
parts.note: 3 x 82 mm toe-nails per joist to the plate (Table 9.23.3.4) and a galvanized uplift clip on each joist, installed before the spray foam (ABC 12).

parts.name: Full-depth blocking, caulked 4 sides (air transfer + fire block)
Wall poly turned 50 onto top plate
Closed-cell spray foam, top-plate poly to deck
Upper sheathing membrane, lapped 100 over wall membrane
Upper sheathing membrane to deck underside
parts.note: Self-adhered collar at each joist where it crosses the membrane: 3 sides, 50 mm onto the membrane (ABC 9).

parts.name: Mineral wool infill between joists (wall-line thermal continuity)
Vapour-permeable wind barrier on eave mineral wool
PT cavity-top closure (cavity not open to soffit)
Closure screws through insulation into top plates
Insect screen across cavity-top vent slot
Larch frieze trim fixed to soffit, 20 mm vent slot below
Self-adhered pre-strip, 50 past interior wall face
PT nailer rip 10, glued and nailed
Bottom nailer ply screws, 2 per joist, 50+ into joist
Bottom nailer ply screws, 2 per joist, 50+ into joist
Larch fascia board 25 (lower), back-primed, ends sealed
Larch fascia board 25 (upper), rebated drip joint
parts.note: Fascia stays under the roof edge (ABC D3 declined: the proposed outboard fascia puts the edge metal through it). Back-primed, end grain sealed; re-coating needs the gutter off, not the roof edge.

parts.name: Stainless fascia screws into joist ends
SBS base sheet, 52 down fascia face
24 ga metal edge: 110 flange, face to 3416, 45 deg drip 12 off face
24 ga continuous cleat engaging the drip
12 mm hem of the edge metal, folded round the cleat tip
Cleat screws at 300 through fascia into nailer
SBS strip-in over flange, 101.6 onto field
Prefinished gutter on 8 mm stand-offs
parts.note: Hangers at 600 max; gutter removable for re-coating the fascia (CMHC-FL 2.25); downspout piped separately to the storm sump.

parts.name: Gutter screws through stand-offs into nailer
Strip footing 550x250, underside at frost depth 450
Capillary break coating on footing top, into keyway
Clear crushed drain rock, 150+ cover, stepped clear of the footing
Non-woven geotextile wrapping the rock envelope
Perforated PVC drain 100, invert at footing underside
parts.note: Falls 0.5–1 % to the storm sump (two-pipe system, roof water piped separately); cleanout at each high point (DEFG E9).

Concrete pier 200, 450+ below grade, top 152+ above, top falls 1:10, chamfered
Stainless standoff post base: base plate
Standoff post base: side straps (12 ga)
White oak post 90x90, end grain 25 above concrete
Butyl/EPDM cap 1.5 on sealed post end grain, lapped 25 down free faces
Concrete pier 200, 450+ below grade, top 152+ above, top falls 1:10, chamfered
Stainless standoff post base: base plate
Standoff post base: side straps (12 ga)
